description: This file is a Perl script used for generating Redboot configurations based on existing images and files. It includes command-line argument parsing, file size calculations, and script generation logic for embedded system boot configurations.

methods.name: parse_num
methods.description: Parses a number that may be in hexadecimal (prefixed with 0x) or decimal form and returns its numeric value.

methods.name: gen_script
methods.description: Generates a Redboot script based on parameters, file sizes, and addresses, outputting a sequence of commands to a specified file.
